paragraphs.en: The sources differ in kind, and Table S8 keeps these kinds apart. Two are active standards projects with no published text: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) P3777, Standard for Benchmarking and Performance Metrics of AI Agents (project authorization request approved 2025-12-10; the sponsor’s page gives a scope but no draft requirements) ( IEEE Standards Association, 2025a ) , and IEEE P3709 on agentic-AI frameworks ( IEEE Standards Association, 2025b ) ; any comparison with them is forward-looking only. The MLCommons Agentic Product Maturity Ladder V0.1 (1 December 2025; eight levels R0, R1, R2, R3a–c, R4, R5) is a prototype proposal that asks for feedback, assesses an agentic product for specific tasks, and is not a standard ( McGregor et al., 2025 ) . Voluntary frameworks and guidance comprise NIST AI RMF 1.0 (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage; NIST, 2023 ) and its Generative AI Profile ( NIST, 2024 ) , the NIST AI Agent Standards Initiative (17 February 2026) and the related request for information, which concern standards development and agent security and publish no assessment method ( National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2026a ; National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2026b ) , the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026, a risk list ASI01 to ASI10 ( OWASP GenAI Security Project, 2025 ) , and the Cloud Security Alliance’s red-teaming guide ( Cloud Security Alliance, 2025 ) . Specifications and tools are the OWASP Agent Control Standard v0.1.0, a public-preview runtime specification ( OWASP GenAI Security Project, 2026 ) , and a vendor governance toolkit in public preview ( Microsoft, 2026b ) . The published standards ISO/IEC 42001:2023 and 23894:2023 concern organizations, and ISO/IEC 22989:2022 defines terminology ( ISO/IEC, 2023b ; ISO/IEC, 2023a ; ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, 2022 ) . No source was found that assesses a single released agent version across engineering areas with graded evidence and a combined score; this is a statement about the sources examined, not a claim that none exists. Five classes are used in the crosswalk: directly mapped with supporting evidence, partially mapped, not mapped, not applicable, and unable to assess. No row qualifies as directly mapped with supporting evidence , because no conformity evidence exists, and the table therefore contains only the other four classes.

paragraphs.en: The overlap is greatest for the security and runtime-governance topics: the OWASP agentic risk list and the control, confidentiality and security levels of the MLCommons ladder correspond to several AgentStripes capabilities, but AgentStripes checks that a mechanism exists and how well it is shown, while these sources describe risks or task-level outcomes . A high rating for Untrusted input separated is therefore not evidence of resistance to goal hijack. ISO/IEC 42001 and 23894 and the Govern function of the NIST framework concern organizations; evidence from a release assessment could be one input to a management system, but it cannot independently establish organizational conformity, and no suggestion is made that stripes indicate it. Gaps are also evident: AgentStripes has no capability for identity lifecycle (ASI03), for the security of inter-agent communication (ASI07), or for the human-factors side of ASI09; it does not measure task performance or consistency (MLCommons R1, R3c, R5); and it has no context-of-use element (NIST Map), to which the governance-context element of Section 4.1 is a first response only. Because P3777 and P3709 have no published requirements, alignment with them is forward-looking only (AgentStripes grades controls, whereas a benchmarking standard would grade task performance), and the mapping should be repeated when drafts are published.
paragraphs.zh: 在安全与运行时治理这两个主题中，重叠程度最高：OWASP 智能体风险清单以及 MLCommons 阶梯模型中的控制、机密性和安全等级，都与 AgentStripes 的若干能力相对应；但 AgentStripes 会检查是否存在相关机制及其实现效果，而这些来源仅描述了风险或任务层面的结果。 因此，在“不可信输入分离”方面获得高分，并不能证明系统具备抵抗目标劫持的能力。 ISO/IEC 42001、23894 以及 NIST 框架中的“治理”功能均涉及组织层面；发布评估中的证据可以作为管理体系的一项输入，但无法独立证明组织符合性，且文中也未提及这些“条带”能表明这一点。 同样存在明显空白：AgentStripes 不具备身份生命周期（ASI03）、智能体间通信安全（ASI07）或 ASI09 中涉及的人为因素方面的能力；它也不测量任务绩效或一致性（MLCommons R1、R3c、R5）；此外，它没有“使用上下文”要素（NIST 映射），而第 4.1 节中的治理上下文要素目前仅作为初步回应。 由于 P3777 和 P3709 尚未发布任何要求，与它们的对齐目前仅具有前瞻性意义（AgentStripes 对控制措施进行评级，而基准测试标准则用于评级任务绩效）；待草案发布后，应重新进行映射。

paragraphs.en: This section specifies a proposed study. It has not been conducted, and no result of it is reported; the empirical evaluation of Section 8 is not this study. Its purpose is to separate the reliability of the assessment from the question of whether stripes predict operational outcomes (Figure S2 ). The population is a sampling frame of pinned agent releases, stratified by framework, domain, autonomy profile (read-only, drafting, acting with approval, acting without approval) and by whether the agent can take consequential actions. Public repositories are one stratum; private deployments are included only with the owner’s consent and under a data-governance agreement, and are analysed as a separate stratum because their configuration differs from a repository. Frame, inclusion and exclusion counts are recorded in a sample-flow table, and included and excluded repositories are compared on observable characteristics. Assessment is independent: assessors are independent of the method’s developers, with at least two human experts per agent, a reference panel adjudicated from their ratings, the deterministic instruments, and LLM judges from at least two providers; human raters do not see the judges’ ratings before rating, and judge models and prompts are recorded as in Section 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节说明了一项拟议的研究。 该研究尚未开展，也未报告其任何结果；第 8 节中的实证评估并非本研究。 其目的是将评估的可靠性与条纹能否预测运行结果的问题区分开来（图 S2）。 总体是一个已固定的智能体释放样本框架，按框架、领域、自主性配置（只读、起草、经批准行动、未经批准行动）以及智能体能否采取具有后果的行动进行分层。 公共存储库是一个分层；私有部署仅在所有者同意且遵循数据治理协议的情况下被纳入，并作为一个独立分层进行分析，因为其配置与存储库不同。 框架、纳入和排除数量记录在样本流表中，并对已纳入和未纳入的存储库的可观察特征进行比较。 评估是独立的：评估者独立于方法的开发者，每个智能体至少由两名人类专家参与，参考小组根据他们的评分进行裁定，确定性工具以及来自至少两家提供商的大型语言模型（LLM）评判者也参与其中；人类评分者在评分前不会看到评判者的评分，而评判模型和提示词则如第 5 节所述进行记录。

paragraphs.en: Five outcomes are defined. (i) Agreement between independent assessors, ordinal α \alpha with exact and within-one agreement and bootstrap intervals clustered by agent. (ii) Stability across repeated assessments. (iii) Sensitivity of S S and the stripes to credits, weights, the stripe width and the treatment of unassessed capabilities. (iv) Controlled outcomes: success and recovery under injected tool and network faults, and violations in authorized attack testing, using suites with held-out cases. (v) Where governed data exist, operational failure and incident rates. Outcomes (iv) and (v) are measured by parties that do not see the stripes.

paragraphs.en: The statistical analysis is pre-specified. Agreement is estimated with Krippendorff’s α \alpha and clustered bootstrap intervals. Score–outcome association is estimated by rank correlation as a descriptive estimand and by a regression with random effects for framework and organization for adjusted estimates; stripes are treated as ordinal. Missing evidence is analysed as missing, not as absent, and non-applicable capabilities are handled as in the scoring rule, with a sensitivity analysis that counts all of them. Calibration of credits and weights uses a development sample and is evaluated on a disjoint held-out sample, so that parameters are not tuned on the data used to judge them. Clustering by agent, framework, organization and assessment batch is modelled. No sample size is stated, because the required assumptions are not yet available. The primary estimand is the half-width of the confidence interval for per-capability α \alpha and for the score–outcome rank correlation. For orientation only: with n n agents, the Fisher z z approximation gives a 95% interval of about tanh ⁡ ( artanh ⁡ ρ ± 1.96 / n − 3 ) \tanh\!\bigl(\operatorname{artanh}\rho\pm 1.96/\sqrt{n-3}\bigr) for a correlation ρ \rho , so a sample of the size of the exploratory empirical evaluation cannot resolve a moderate association. A provisional target is to fix the acceptable half-width on an exploratory sample and then choose n n by simulation from the variances observed there; this rationale is provisional.
paragraphs.zh: 统计分析是预先指定的。 一致性通过 Krippendorff’s α \alpha 和聚类自助区间进行估计。 分数–结果关联通过秩相关作为描述性估计量进行估计，并通过包含框架和组织随机效应的回归模型获得调整后的估计值；条纹被处理为有序变量。 缺失证据被分析为“缺失”，而非“不存在”；不适用能力则按照评分规则处理，并进行敏感性分析以计入所有此类情况。 信用和权重的校准使用开发样本完成，并在一个独立的预留样本上进行评估，以确保参数不会基于用于评判它们的数据进行调整。 按智能体、框架、组织和评估批次进行的聚类被纳入模型。 未说明样本量，因为所需的假设条件尚未具备。 主要估计量是每项能力 α \alpha 的置信区间半宽以及分数–结果秩相关的置信区间半宽。 仅用于说明：假设有 n n 个智能体，Fisher z z 近似法可得出 95% 置信区间约为 tanh ⁡ ( artanh ⁡ ρ ± 1.96 / n − 3 ) \tanh\!\bigl(\operatorname{artanh}\rho\pm 1.96/\sqrt{n-3}\bigr)，其中 ρ \rho 为相关系数；因此，探索性经验评估规模的样本无法识别出中等强度的关联。 初步目标是先在一个探索性样本中确定可接受的半宽，然后通过模拟基于其中观察到的方差来选择 n n；这一依据仅为临时性的。

sents.en: Score–outcome association is estimated by rank correlation as a descriptive estimand and by a regression with random effects for framework and organization for adjusted estimates; stripes are treated as ordinal.

sents.en: Missing evidence is analysed as missing, not as absent, and non-applicable capabilities are handled as in the scoring rule, with a sensitivity analysis that counts all of them.

sents.en: Calibration of credits and weights uses a development sample and is evaluated on a disjoint held-out sample, so that parameters are not tuned on the data used to judge them.

sents.zh: 按智能体、框架、组织和评估批次进行的聚类被纳入模型。

sents.en: No sample size is stated, because the required assumptions are not yet available.
sents.zh: 未说明样本量，因为所需的假设条件尚未具备。

sents.en: The primary estimand is the half-width of the confidence interval for per-capability α \alpha and for the score–outcome rank correlation.

paragraphs.en: Hypotheses H1–H5 of Section 4.2 , the primary outcomes, the exclusion criteria and the thresholds are to be registered before any assessment of the confirmatory sample, and a hypothesis that is not supported is reported as such. Blocker validation uses a larger stratified set, with independent reference judgements of harm risk, to estimate false-positive and false-negative rates of each blocker, per agent type and consequential-action profile. Reliability and validity are kept separate: arms (i)–(iii) can be completed without any outcome data and answer whether the instrument is reproducible, arms (iv)–(v) answer whether it is useful, a result on the first group says nothing about the second, and reports state which group each result belongs to.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节中的假设 H1–H5、主要结果、排除标准和阈值必须在对确认样本进行任何评估之前注册，且未得到支持的假设应明确报告为未获支持。 阻断剂验证使用一个更大的分层样本集，并结合独立的危害风险参考判断，以估算每种阻断剂在各类智能体类型和后果行动配置下的假阳性率和假阴性率。 可靠性和有效性被分开处理：分支 (i)–(iii) 无需任何结果数据即可完成，用于判断该工具是否具有可重复性；分支 (iv)–(v) 则用于判断其有效性；第一组的结果对第二组毫无影响，且报告需明确说明每个结果属于哪一组。

paragraphs.en: This section describes an empirical evaluation of the maturity model (exploratory, non-confirmatory), that is, an application of the method to 30 public agent repositories, and Section 9 reports what it produced. The evaluation is not the confirmatory study of Section 7 : it tests none of the hypotheses H1–H5, uses no human rater and no outcome data, and its sample is purposive and not drawn from the frame of Section 3.5 . Its purpose is narrower: to show what the method produces when it is run as specified on real repositories with static evidence only, how much of that output survives a repeated assessment, and which rules of the specification decide the result. The analysis is descriptive. Nothing in it is a validation of the method, no ranking of the repositories is made, and no claim is made that the stripes predict reliability or safety.
paragraphs.zh: 本节描述了对成熟度模型（探索性、非验证性）的经验评估，即将该方法应用于 30 个公开的智能体仓库，第 9 节将报告其结果。 该评估并非第 7 节中的验证性研究：它未检验任何 H1–H5 假设，未使用人类评分者或结果数据，且其样本为目的性抽样，而非从第 3.5 节的总体框架中抽取。 其目的更为有限：展示当该方法按照指定规则仅基于静态证据在真实仓库上运行时会产生什么结果，这些结果在重复评估中有多少能保持一致，以及规范中的哪些规则决定了最终结果。 该分析属于描述性分析。 其中没有任何内容是对该方法的验证，也未对仓库进行排名，更没有声称这些“条纹”能够预测可靠性或安全性。

paragraphs.en: What was fixed in advance is stated first. The selection criteria were written, with a date (a date-stamped file in the study package), before any repository was searched. The engine was not frozen in advance: it was revised three times after results on this same sample had been seen (agent detector and secrets-scanner allowlist; file ranking and loader fix; a tiered ranking of agent-loop files and the README). Only results from the final version, 0.2.2, are reported, for all 30 repositories; earlier runs are archived and are not reported as results, and their results are not comparable with these. The sensitivity analyses of Section 6 were specified after the results were known, so the evaluation is development on a test sample and describes what the method as run produces on it, not what a pre-registered study would find.
paragraphs.zh: 事先确定的内容首先被陈述。 在选择标准编写之前（研究包中有一份带日期戳的文件），尚未搜索任何仓库。 引擎并未事先固定：在查看同一样本的结果后，它经过了三次修订（智能体检测器和 secrets-scanner 白名单；文件排名和加载器修复；智能体循环文件的分层排名以及 README）。 所有 30 个仓库仅报告最终版本 0.2.2 的结果；早期运行已被归档且不作为结果报告，其结果也与这些结果不可比。 第 6 节的敏感性分析是在已知结果之后才指定的，因此该评估是对测试样本的开发过程，描述了实际运行该方法在该样本上的产出，而非预先注册的研究会得出什么结论。

paragraphs.en: The selection criteria were: a public GitHub repository whose primary language is Python, with at least 500 stars, a push on or after 2026-04-11, not archived, and an MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD licence; containing an agent that does real work, meaning a language model calling tools (function calling or MCP) in a loop, verified by reading the repository files; and an identifiable sub-folder that holds the agent code (the agent target ). Prompt collections, tutorials, curated lists, pure model or SDK wrappers without a loop, toy demonstrations with fewer than three tools and interface-only shells were excluded, as were four further repositories excluded by decision of the study owner before assessment. As in Section 3.5 , no inclusion criterion used a rated capability. The target strata were about 6 frameworks, 14 task applications, 6 coding, computer-use or browser agents and 4 enterprise or vertical agents; the realised counts are 7, 12, 6 and 5 (Table S11 ). An independent re-verification through the GitHub interface (without cloning) passed the metadata and commit integrity of all 30 repositories and of 5 reserves; on content it gave 26 passes (9 with caveats), 2 corrections of the agent target and 2 replacements, which were made before assessment. The repositories carry 20 MIT and 10 Apache-2.0 licences; stars have a median of 29,874 (minimum 2,990, maximum 252,731). This is a popularity-filtered convenience sample in which several repositories cluster thematically, and it supports no inference about agents in general.
paragraphs.zh: 筛选标准如下：一个以 Python 为主要语言、至少有 500 颗星的公开 GitHub 仓库，在 2026-04-11 或之后有提交记录，未归档，且采用 MIT、Apache-2.0 或 BSD 许可证；其中包含一个能执行实际工作的智能体，即通过循环调用工具（函数调用或 MCP）的语言模型，并通过读取仓库文件进行验证；此外，还需存在一个可识别的子文件夹用于存放智能体代码（即智能体目标）。 提示词集合、教程、精选列表、无循环结构的纯模型或 SDK 包装器、工具少于三种的玩具式演示以及仅包含接口的壳程序均被排除在外；此外，研究负责人在评估前还决定排除了另外四个仓库。 与第 3.5 节一样，没有任何入选标准使用了评级能力指标。 目标分层包括约 6 个框架、14 个任务应用、6 个编码、计算机操作或浏览器智能体，以及 4 个企业或垂直领域智能体；实际统计数量分别为 7、12、6 和 5（表 S11）。 通过 GitHub 界面（无需克隆）进行的独立重新验证确认了全部 30 个仓库及 5 个备用仓库的元数据和提交完整性；在内容验证方面，有 26 个通过（9 个附带说明），2 个智能体目标需要修正，以及 2 个需要替换，这些调整均在评估前完成。 这些仓库采用 20 份 MIT 许可证和 10 份 Apache-2.0 许可证；星星数量的中位数为 29,874（最小值 2,990，最大值 252,731）。 这是一个经过流行度筛选的便利样本，其中多个仓库在主题上存在聚集现象，因此无法据此对智能体整体做出推断。

paragraphs.en: For the assessment as run, each repository was pinned to a commit and read by the engine, which parsed the code, ran its deterministic instruments, and built a ranked dossier of the most relevant files, of at most 90,000 characters with each file truncated at 14,000. Each of 3 judges rated the 40 capabilities in 12 areas from 0 to 3, or abstained where the excerpts did not allow a decision, backing every rating above 0 with a quote. Acceptance, aggregation and arithmetic are those of Section 3 (the median of the accepted ratings, the lower middle value for two; at least two accepted ratings; the five stages of Section 3.4 ). The policies that the specification fixes only partly were set as follows: unassessed capabilities are excluded from the score (Section 3.4 ), emerging capabilities count only when they raise the running mean, and no independent review or runtime evidence was used in the scores. Because no agent was run, the highest evidence level reachable is E2.
paragraphs.zh: 在本次评估运行中，每个仓库都被固定到一个提交版本并由引擎读取；引擎解析了代码，执行了其确定性工具，并构建了一份按相关性排序的文件档案，总字符数最多为 90,000，每份文件的长度则被截断至 14,000。 3 位评委中的每一位对 12 个领域内的 40 项能力进行了 0 到 3 的评分；若摘录内容不足以做出判断，则选择弃权，且所有高于 0 的评分均附有引文支持。 接受、汇总和计算均遵循第 3 节的规则（即已接受评分的中位数，对于两个评分则取较低的中位值；至少需要两个已接受的评分；以及第 3.4 节中的五个阶段）。 规范仅部分固定的政策如下：未评估的能力不计入得分（第 3.4 节）；新兴能力仅在提升当前平均值时才会被计入；且评分中未使用任何独立审查或运行时证据。 由于没有运行任何智能体，可达到的最高证据级别为 E2。

sents.en: For the assessment as run, each repository was pinned to a commit and read by the engine, which parsed the code, ran its deterministic instruments, and built a ranked dossier of the most relevant files, of at most 90,000 characters with each file truncated at 14,000.
sents.zh: 在本次评估运行中，每个仓库都被固定到一个提交版本并由引擎读取；引擎解析了代码，执行了其确定性工具，并构建了一份按相关性排序的文件档案，总字符数最多为 90,000，每份文件的长度则被截断至 14,000。

sents.en: Each of 3 judges rated the 40 capabilities in 12 areas from 0 to 3, or abstained where the excerpts did not allow a decision, backing every rating above 0 with a quote.
sents.zh: 3 位评委中的每一位对 12 个领域内的 40 项能力进行了 0 到 3 的评分；若摘录内容不足以做出判断，则选择弃权，且所有高于 0 的评分均附有引文支持。

sents.en: Acceptance, aggregation and arithmetic are those of Section 3 (the median of the accepted ratings, the lower middle value for two; at least two accepted ratings; the five stages of Section 3.4 ).
sents.zh: 接受、汇总和计算均遵循第 3 节的规则（即已接受评分的中位数，对于两个评分则取较低的中位值；至少需要两个已接受的评分；以及第 3.4 节中的五个阶段）。

sents.en: The policies that the specification fixes only partly were set as follows: unassessed capabilities are excluded from the score (Section 3.4 ), emerging capabilities count only when they raise the running mean, and no independent review or runtime evidence was used in the scores.
sents.zh: 规范仅部分固定的政策如下：未评估的能力不计入得分（第 3.4 节）；新兴能力仅在提升当前平均值时才会被计入；且评分中未使用任何独立审查或运行时证据。

sents.en: Because no agent was run, the highest evidence level reachable is E2.
sents.zh: 由于没有运行任何智能体，可达到的最高证据级别为 E2。

paragraphs.en: The engine credits every accepted code-reading (E2) rating at 0.90 0.90 instead of the table value 0.70 0.70 of Table 3 , and documentation (E1) at 0.50 0.50 ; in this run all 826 E2 cells carry 0.90 0.90 and all 136 E1 cells 0.50 0.50 (two rated cells without a quote earn E0). This is the documented rule of the engine for static assessments, but it is broader than the single exception described in Section 3.2 (whose membership is not enumerated; Section 11 ), so absolute scores below are conditional on this reading of the rule, and static code evidence (0.90) earns more than evidence from the developer’s runs (E3, 0.85). The effect of setting the E2 credit to 0.70 0.70 is reported in Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 该引擎将每个被接受的代码阅读（E2）评分按 0.90 0.90 计算，而非表 3 中给出的 0.70 0.70；文档（E1）则按 0.50 0.50 计算。在此运行中，全部 826 个 E2 单元格均计为 0.90 0.90，全部 136 个 E1 单元格均计为 0.50 0.50（两个未带引号的评分单元格则计为 E0）。 这是该引擎针对静态评估的既定规则，但其范围比第 3.2 节中描述的单一例外情况更广泛（该例外的具体成员并未列出；见第 11 节）。因此，下文提到的绝对分数均基于对该规则的解释，且静态代码证据（0.90）所获得的分数高于来自开发者运行结果的证据（E3，0.85）。 将 E2 的计分值设为 0.70 0.70 所产生的影响将在第 6 节中报告。

paragraphs.en: The judges were Claude subagents, called through the harness under the alias sonnet and recorded as “claude-sonnet (subagent)”; the model snapshot was not pinned and cannot be recovered from the stored files. There were three judges per repository and 90 answer sets in all, all of them accepted. The panel is one model family, so its errors are likely to be correlated, and the judges were not confined to the dossier: they had file-system access in their harness, and 16 accepted quotes verify only in files that were not shown to the judge. The statement of Section 3.5 that judge models are pinned, and the requirement of Section 7 of judges from at least two providers, were therefore not met in the empirical evaluation, which was also run by the method’s developers, not by independent assessors.
paragraphs.zh: 评审员是 Claude 子智能体，通过工具包以“sonnet”的别名进行调用，并记录为“claude-sonnet（子智能体）”；模型快照并未固定，无法从存储的文件中恢复。 每个仓库有三名评审员，共有 90 组答案，且全部被接受。 该评审小组属于同一个模型家族，因此其错误很可能存在相关性；此外，评审员的权限并不局限于案卷：他们的工具包具备文件系统访问权限，而 16 条被接受的引文仅能在未向评审员展示的文件中得到验证。 因此，第 3.5 节中关于评审模型已固定的声明，以及第 7 节中要求评审员至少来自两家供应商的规定，在实证评估中均未得到满足；而该评估也是由该方法的开发人员而非独立评估者执行的。

paragraphs.en: The analyses are descriptive (Sections 9.2 – 9.4 ). Stability was assessed in two separate comparisons. Twenty-two repositories were judged a second time with a fresh panel on the final engine, after being judged on engine 0.2.1; engine, dossier and panel differ between the two assessments. Eight repositories had been re-judged on the final engine first, after a review found that their dossiers did not show the agent loop or most guard code, so a 0.2.1 comparison was not informative for them; they were repeated by a fresh panel of three judges on the same engine and the same dossier, a panel-only comparison whose estimate is indicative only (the eight are not a random subset, and the judges were not sandboxed), and are all at one final stripe. For every repository a calculation trace records each stage of Section 3.4 , and a replay of the engine’s scoring on the stored ratings reproduces the score and final stripes for 30 of 30 results. All inputs and outputs are kept in the study package, and the numbers and tables are generated from its result files by a script; the supplement lists the results alphabetically, the pinned commits and engine hashes, the regeneration procedure and one worked calculation (Section S3 ). The judge answers cannot be reproduced exactly (unpinned model, no seed), as Section 9.3 shows.
paragraphs.zh: 这些分析属于描述性分析（第 9.2 – 9.4 节）。 稳定性通过两次独立的比较进行评估。 在基于 0.2.1 版本引擎完成评估后，又有 22 个存储库针对最终引擎由新的评审小组进行了第二次评估；两次评估中使用的引擎、档案和评审小组均不相同。 有 8 个存储库先是在最终引擎上重新接受了评估，此前一项审查发现它们的档案未体现智能体循环或大部分防护代码，因此基于 0.2.1 版本的比较对它们而言并无实际意义；随后由三名新评审员组成的团队在同一引擎和同一档案上对这些存储库进行了重复评估。这是一项仅涉及评审小组的比较，其估算结果仅供参考（这 8 个存储库并非随机子集，评审员也未处于沙箱环境中），且所有结果均处于最终等级。 对于每个存储库，计算追踪都记录了第 3.4 节的各个阶段；通过重新运行引擎对已存储评分的打分过程，可重现 30 个结果中的全部 30 个得分和最终等级。 所有输入和输出均保留在研究包中，相关数字和表格由脚本从其中的结果文件生成；补充材料按字母顺序列出了所有结果、已固定的提交记录与引擎哈希值、再生成流程以及一个完整的计算示例（第 S3 节）。 如第 9.3 节所示，评审员的回答无法被完全重现（模型未固定，且无随机种子）。

Distributions and aggregate counts are reported. The repositories are not ranked, no statement is made about which named repository has or lacks a capability, and the stripes are not read as predictors of reliability or safety; the per-repository table is in the supplement, alphabetical and labelled as not a ranking. paragraphs.en: All 30 repositories were assessed as agents, and all 90 judge answer sets were accepted by the engine, so that 3 of 3 judges contribute to every repository. The judges were shown between 8 and 26 files per repository (median 11), and for 6 repositories the loader reached its total-file cap, with the agent folder read first. Across the 1200 repository–capability cells, 964 were rated, 225 (18.8%) ended unassessed because fewer than two accepted ratings remained, and 11 were not applicable. The rated cells hold 48 ratings of 0, 285 of 1, 563 of 2 and 68 of 3, with evidence 826 times at E2, 136 at E1 and twice at E0. The coverage κ \kappa , the share of applicable capabilities with an accepted rating, has a mean of 81.1% (median 85.0%, range 35.0% to 97.5%), and between 12 and 36 of the 40 capabilities were counted in the score of a repository. 4 repositories meet the stated low-confidence rule (coverage below 70% or fewer than 20 counted capabilities); for them the score describes a subset of capabilities determined by the judges’ abstentions.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 30 个仓库均被评估为智能体，且全部 90 组法官答案集均被引擎接受，因此每位法官的 3 份评估结果都适用于每个仓库。 每位法官在每个仓库中看到的文件数量在 8 到 26 个之间（中位数为 11），对于 6 个仓库，加载器达到了其总文件上限，其中智能体文件夹被优先读取。 在 1200 个仓库–能力单元格中，有 964 个进行了评级；225 个（18.8%）因剩余的有效评级少于两个而未被评估；另有 11 个不适用。 已评级的单元格包含 48 个 0 分、285 个 1 分、563 个 2 分和 68 个 3 分；证据在 E2 级别的出现次数为 826 次，E1 级别为 136 次，E0 级别为 2 次。 覆盖率 κ \kappa（即具有有效评级的适用能力所占比例）的平均值为 81.1%（中位数为 85.0%，范围在 35.0% 至 97.5% 之间），且每个仓库的评分中包含了 40 项能力中的 12 到 36 项。有 4 个仓库符合所设定的低置信度规则（覆盖率低于 70% 或计入的能力少于 20 项）；对于这些仓库，其评分仅反映了法官们未参与评估的部分能力。

paragraphs.en: 26 repositories end at one stripe and 4 at two stripes; none ends at 0 or at three or more (Table 4 , Figure S6 ). The distinction between the two groups is not reliable, and Sections 9.2 and 9.3 document why. Before the blockers apply, scores run from 39.7 to 69.7 (mean 50.8, median 51.1), which corresponds to three, four or five score stripes (11, 18 and 1 repositories). The score therefore does not determine the final stripe, and the gap between score stripes and final stripes is produced by the blockers, not by the scores. The score is only moderately related to coverage: the Spearman correlation between the two is 0.51 and between score and stars 0.24 ( n = 30 n=30 ; descriptive, untested), and because unassessed capabilities are excluded, a score on thin coverage is an average over whatever the judges chose to rate (Figure S6 ). Area scores, the weighted mean credit in each of the 12 areas, are spread widely over the repositories, so means conceal large differences between repositories; two areas (data and privacy, runtime governance) consist only of emerging capabilities, so their scores are conditioned on a favourable selection and are not comparable with those of the other areas. Among the 10 other areas mean area scores span about 24.8 points (36.9 to 61.7), and the spread within an area is wider than the spread between area means (Figures 3 and 4 ). The area profiles are aggregates only: each spoke is computed separately over 8 to 30 repositories, so a polygon is a pointwise median and not the profile of any agent, and the area scores lie on a coarse lattice (about 30, 60 or 90 points for ratings of 1, 2 or 3 with static evidence), so medians of exactly 60 and bands of zero width are quantisation effects. No per-repository profile is shown : with the public per-repository results table, even unlabelled profiles on this lattice could be matched to repositories, which would turn them into per-repository claims that are unstable (Section 9.3 ) and that this paper does not make. The unassessed share of cells varies from 5% to 36% between areas; counts per capability and profiles by stratum are in the supplement (Table S21 , Figure S7 ).

paragraphs.en: The ceiling of two stripes is a property of the method applied to static evidence, not of the repositories. Evidence from a repository alone stops at E2, and the proof blocker (Section 3.4 ) limits the final stripes to 2 whenever the weakest evidence level among the four safety behaviours is below E3 or unrated. That holds for all 30 repositories, so “final ≤ 2 \leq 2 ” is built in and says nothing about them; as an arithmetic illustration, not a finding, removing the proof limit and changing nothing else would leave 26 repositories at one stripe and would put the 4 repositories now at two at four. The only repository-level information in the final stripe is therefore whether any of the five safety capabilities has a median rating below 2 (plus, for three repositories, the basics blocker), since one such rating forces the final stripe to 1. The safety blocker binds for 23 repositories, proof for 4, basics together with safety for 2 and basics alone for 1 (Table 4 ). Execution isolated has a median rating below 2 in 16 repositories, Consequential actions controlled in 15, Untrusted input separated in 3, Runs bounded in 3 and Failures surfaced in 1; the number of repositories with 0, 1, 2 and 3 safety capabilities below 2 is 5, 13, 11 and 1, 13 repositories are held at one stripe by exactly one capability, and of the 5 repositories with none below 2, 4 are the two-stripe results and the remaining one is held at 1 by the basics blocker. The rule counts a rating of 1 (basic) as below the bar, so that safeguards that exist only as an opt-in in a framework can read as absent, which is a question about the construct for frameworks and not only about the repositories; the final stripe is a decision by one OR-rule over five capabilities. Figure 5 places these counts on the model’s levels and gates: the score stripes lie at three to five, and the gates move every repository to one or two. The evidence credits, the ceiling by evidence level and the observed evidence levels are shown in Figure 6 ; the credit of code evidence is 0.90 0.90 in the engine against 0.70 0.70 in the model’s table, which is why the credit ladder is not monotonic (Section 10.2 ), and the only level above E2 in the evaluation is the E3 of the probe-run demonstration of Section 9.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 两条条纹的上限是应用于静态证据的方法的属性，而非存储库的属性。 仅来自一个存储库的证据会止步于 E2，而证明阻断器（第 3.4 节）会将最终条纹限制为 2，只要四个安全行为中最弱的证据等级低于 E3 或未评级。 这一结论适用于全部 30 个存储库，因此“最终 ≤ 2 \leq 2”是内置的，并未说明这些存储库的任何信息；作为一个算术示例而非发现结果，如果移除证明限制且其他一切不变，则会有 26 个存储库保持一条条纹，而目前处于两条条纹的 4 个存储库则会变为四条条纹。 因此，最终条纹中唯一与存储库级别相关的信息是：五个安全能力中是否有任何一项的中位数评级低于 2（此外，对于三个存储库，还包括基础能力阻断器），因为只要有一项评级如此，最终条纹就会被强制为 1。 安全阻断器对 23 个存储库生效，证明阻断器对 4 个生效，基础能力与安全能力结合对 2 个生效，仅基础能力阻断器对 1 个生效（表 4）。 在 16 个存储库中，“执行隔离”的中位数评级低于 2；“后果行动受控”在 15 个中生效，“不可信输入分离”在 3 个中生效，“运行受限”在 3 个中生效，“故障暴露”在 1 个中生效；有 0、1、2 和 3 项安全能力评级低于 2 的存储库数量分别为 5、13、11 和 1；有 13 个存储库因恰好一项能力而保持一条条纹；而在 5 个无能力评级低于 2 的存储库中，4 个是两条条纹的结果，其余 1 个因基础能力阻断器而保持一条条纹。 该规则将评级为 1（基础）视为低于标准线，因此那些在框架中仅作为可选项存在的安全保障可能被解读为不存在；这涉及框架构建方式的问题，而不仅仅是存储库的问题；最终条纹是通过一项 OR 规则对五个能力进行决策的结果。 图 5 将这些计数置于模型的不同层级和门控上：得分条纹位于三到五之间，而门控则将所有存储库转移至一条或两条条纹。 证据积分、基于证据等级的上限以及观测到的证据等级均显示在图 6 中；代码证据的积分在引擎中为 0.90 0.90，而在模型的表格中则为 0.70 0.70，这就是为什么积分阶梯并非单调递增（第 10.2 节）；评估中唯一高于 E2 的等级是第 9.4 节中探针运行演示所达到的 E3。

paragraphs.en: Table S14 lists four sensitivity analyses that recompute the arithmetic from the stored ratings; they are sensitivities and not results, and they do not change what the panel rated. Counting each unassessed capability as a rating of 0, instead of leaving it out of the score as in the primary policy, lowers every score, by a median of 7.5 points, and lowers the score stripes of 19 repositories, while the ordering of the scores is largely preserved ( ρ = 0.85 \rho=0.85 ) and no final stripe changes; scores are therefore policy-dependent. The blocker code ignores an unassessed capability, so a safety capability that the judges declined to rate cannot hold a repository at one stripe, and the score-level analysis does not test this. In 9 repositories 14 of the 150 safety cells are unassessed; if each of them is rated 0, 3 of the 4 two-stripe results drop to one stripe and the distribution becomes 29 at one stripe and 1 at two. Specifically, 3 of the 4 two-stripe results would drop to one stripe if the unassessed safety capability were rated 0, and one stands without that dependence, so the 1-versus-2 distinction is unreliable under this analysis alone. The basics blocker also ignores unassessed capabilities: if every unassessed applicable basics capability were rated 0 (a worst-case convention), 8 repositories would fall to zero stripes, none of them a two-stripe result, and setting safety to 0 as well gives 8, 21 and 1 repositories at 0, 1 and 2 stripes. Setting the E2 credit to 0.70 0.70 (Section 8 ) lowers the mean score by − - 10.72 points (range − - 14.94 to − - 8.33), changes the score stripes of 28 of 30 repositories, and changes no final stripe and no binding label; the Spearman correlation with the primary scores is 0.994. Absolute scores are conditional on the credit rule, whereas the final stripes are not sensitive to it, but this robustness is to the credit only and says nothing about the noise of the judging, which Section 9.3 measures.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S14 列出了四项敏感性分析，这些分析基于已存储的评分重新计算了算术结果；它们属于敏感性分析而非最终结果，且不会改变专家组原有的评分。 将每个未评估的能力计为 0 分（而非像主要政策那样从得分中排除），会使所有得分降低，其中中位降幅为 7.5 分，同时有 19 个知识库的得分等级也会下降；不过得分的排序基本保持不变（ρ = 0.85 \rho=0.85），且最终得分等级未发生任何变化；因此，这些得分依赖于具体政策。 阻断代码会忽略未评估的能力，因此，若评审员拒绝对某项安全能力进行评分，该能力便无法使知识库维持某一得分等级，而得分层级的分析并未对此进行测试。 在 9 个知识库中，150 个安全单元格中有 14 个未被评估；如果每个未评估的单元格都被评为 0 分，那么原本为双等级结果的 3 个知识库将降至单等级，最终分布变为 29 个单等级和 1 个双等级结果。 具体而言，如果未评估的安全能力被评定为 0 分，原本为双等级结果的 4 个案例中将有 3 个降至单等级，而其中一个结果则不受此影响；因此，仅凭这项分析无法可靠地区分单等级与双等级的差异。 基础阻断规则同样会忽略未评估的能力：如果所有适用的未评估基础能力都被评定为 0 分（一种最坏情况假设），将有 8 个知识库降至零等级，且这些结果中无一为双等级；若再将安全能力也设为 0 分，则分别有 8、21 和 1 个知识库处于 0、1 和 2 等级。 将 E2 信用值设为 0.70 0.70（第 8 节）会使平均得分下降 − - 10.72 分（范围 − - 14.94 至 − - 8.33），改变 30 个知识库中 28 个的得分等级，但不会改变任何最终得分等级或约束性标签；其与主要得分的斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.994。 绝对得分取决于信用规则，而最终得分等级对此并不敏感；但这种稳健性仅针对信用规则本身，并未反映评审过程中的噪声情况，后者将在第 9.3 节中加以测量。

sents.zh: 阻断代码会忽略未评估的能力，因此，若评审员拒绝对某项安全能力进行评分，该能力便无法使知识库维持某一得分等级，而得分层级的分析并未对此进行测试。

sents.en: In 9 repositories 14 of the 150 safety cells are unassessed; if each of them is rated 0, 3 of the 4 two-stripe results drop to one stripe and the distribution becomes 29 at one stripe and 1 at two.
sents.zh: 在 9 个知识库中，150 个安全单元格中有 14 个未被评估；如果每个未评估的单元格都被评为 0 分，那么原本为双等级结果的 3 个知识库将降至单等级，最终分布变为 29 个单等级和 1 个双等级结果。

sents.en: Specifically, 3 of the 4 two-stripe results would drop to one stripe if the unassessed safety capability were rated 0, and one stands without that dependence, so the 1-versus-2 distinction is unreliable under this analysis alone.
sents.zh: 具体而言，如果未评估的安全能力被评定为 0 分，原本为双等级结果的 4 个案例中将有 3 个降至单等级，而其中一个结果则不受此影响；因此，仅凭这项分析无法可靠地区分单等级与双等级的差异。

sents.en: The basics blocker also ignores unassessed capabilities: if every unassessed applicable basics capability were rated 0 (a worst-case convention), 8 repositories would fall to zero stripes, none of them a two-stripe result, and setting safety to 0 as well gives 8, 21 and 1 repositories at 0, 1 and 2 stripes.
sents.zh: 基础阻断规则同样会忽略未评估的能力：如果所有适用的未评估基础能力都被评定为 0 分（一种最坏情况假设），将有 8 个知识库降至零等级，且这些结果中无一为双等级；若再将安全能力也设为 0 分，则分别有 8、21 和 1 个知识库处于 0、1 和 2 等级。

sents.en: Setting the E2 credit to 0.70 0.70 (Section 8 ) lowers the mean score by − - 10.72 points (range − - 14.94 to − - 8.33), changes the score stripes of 28 of 30 repositories, and changes no final stripe and no binding label; the Spearman correlation with the primary scores is 0.994.
sents.zh: 将 E2 信用值设为 0.70 0.70（第 8 节）会使平均得分下降 − - 10.72 分（范围 − - 14.94 至 − - 8.33），改变 30 个知识库中 28 个的得分等级，但不会改变任何最终得分等级或约束性标签；其与主要得分的斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.994。

sents.en: Absolute scores are conditional on the credit rule, whereas the final stripes are not sensitive to it, but this robustness is to the credit only and says nothing about the noise of the judging, which Section 9.3 measures.
sents.zh: 绝对得分取决于信用规则，而最终得分等级对此并不敏感；但这种稳健性仅针对信用规则本身，并未反映评审过程中的噪声情况，后者将在第 9.3 节中加以测量。

paragraphs.en: Stability was examined in two separate comparisons (Table S13 ). In the first, twenty-two repositories judged twice were compared: first on engine 0.2.1 with a first panel, and then on engine 0.2.2 with a fresh panel. For some of them the dossier also changed, so the engine, the dossier and the judge sample differ and cannot be separated; the comparison is a stability finding about the method as run, not an estimate of judge noise alone, and the 0.2.1 results are not otherwise reported. The mean absolute change in score is 2.04 points (median 1.81; largest 4.93; 7 of 22 above 3 points; none above 5), and the mean signed change is close to zero, so the second panel reproduces the overall level of the scores but not the individual scores (Spearman correlation 0.891). 220 of 880 rating cells (25%) differ, 103 of them between ratings in both panels (50 raised, 53 lowered). The final stripe changed for 4 of the 22 repositories, 2 from 1 to 2 and 2 from 2 to 1, and the binding-blocker label changed for 6. The first panel’s 22 contained 4 two-stripe results and the second panel’s 4; only 2 repositories are two-stripe in both, out of 6 that are two-stripe in at least one. The changes are driven by safety capabilities moving between rated below 2, rated 2 and unassessed. Single-repository scores and the 1-versus-2 outcome should therefore not be ranked or compared.
paragraphs.zh: 稳定性通过两次独立的比较进行了检验（表 S13）。 在第一次比较中，对二十二个被评估两次的知识库进行了对比：首先使用引擎 0.2.1 和第一组评审员进行评估，然后使用引擎 0.2.2 和另一组新的评审员进行评估。 对于其中一些知识库，其档案也发生了变化，因此引擎、档案和评审员样本均存在差异且无法分离；这种比较反映的是方法执行过程中的稳定性结果，而非仅对评审员噪声的估计，并且 0.2.1 版本的结果未在其他部分报告。 评分的绝对平均变化为 2.04 分（中位数为 1.81；最大值为 4.93；22 个中有 7 个超过 3 分；无一超过 5 分），而带符号变化的平均值接近于零，因此第二组评审员再现了评分的整体水平，但未能再现个体评分（斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.891）。在 880 个评级单元格中，有 220 个（25%）存在差异，其中 103 个在两组评审员的评级中均不同（53 个上升，50 个下降）。 在 22 个知识库中，有 4 个的最终条纹发生了变化：2 个从 1 变为 2，另外 2 个从 2 变为 1；同时有 6 个知识库的“绑定阻断剂”标签发生了变化。 第一组评审员的 22 个结果中包含 4 个双条纹结果，第二组评审员的结果中也包含 4 个；在至少一个评审组中呈现双条纹的 6 个知识库中，仅有 2 个在两组中均为双条纹。 这些变化主要由安全能力在不同评级区间之间的转移所驱动：从低于 2 的评级、2 的评级以及未评估状态之间的转移。 因此，不应对单个知识库的评分或“1 与 2”的结果进行排序或比较。

paragraphs.en: The eight remaining repositories are not part of that comparison, because their earlier dossier did not show the agent loop or most guard code and was replaced. They form a separate, panel-only comparison: each was judged again with the same engine 0.2.2 and the same dossier by a fresh panel of three judges (primary results verified unchanged), which isolates the effect of the judge panel more cleanly than the 22 pairs (changes per repeat are listed by index in Table S15 of the supplement). The estimate is only indicative: the eight were not drawn at random but selected because their earlier dossier had been replaced, and the judges were not sandboxed (the prompts forbade reading other results, but non-access cannot be proven from the stored files). The mean absolute score change is 1.39 points (median 1.02; largest 3.44), the Spearman correlation is 0.881, and 42 of 320 rating cells (13.1%) differ. No final stripe and no binding-blocker label changed. This does not show that the final stripe is stable: all eight repositories sit at one stripe in the primary results, so the repeats cannot show changes between one and two stripes, and eight repositories are too few to bound the rate of such changes. Pooling the two comparisons for description only (30 repositories) gives a mean absolute score change of 1.87 points and a Spearman correlation of 0.893; the 4 changes of the final stripe all occur among the 22 pairs. Figure 7 shows the score changes of the 22 pairs and the 8 repeats (changes only, no marking of individual repositories) and the final-stripe distribution under the policies of Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 其余八个存储库未包含在该比较中，因为它们之前的档案并未显示智能体循环或大部分防护代码，且已被替换。 它们构成一个独立的、仅针对评审小组的比较：每个存储库都使用相同的引擎 0.2.2 和相同的档案，由一个新的三人评审小组重新评估（主要结果经核实未发生变化），这种方式比 22 对比较能更清晰地隔离评审小组的影响（每次重复的变化按索引列于补充材料的表 S15）。 该估算值仅具指示意义：这八个存储库并非随机抽取，而是因其之前的档案被替换而被选中；此外，评审人员并未处于沙箱环境中（提示语禁止阅读其他结果，但无法从已存储的文件中证实他们未访问这些内容）。 平均绝对评分变化为 1.39 分（中位数为 1.02；最大值为 3.44），斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.881，且 320 个评分单元格中有 42 个（13.1%）存在差异。 最终条纹和绑定阻断标签均未发生变化。 这并不能说明最终条纹是稳定的：在主要结果中，所有八个存储库都位于同一条纹，因此重复测试无法显示第一与第二条纹之间的变化；此外，仅凭八个存储库太少，不足以界定此类变化的发生频率。 仅为描述目的将两次比较合并（共 30 个存储库），得出平均绝对评分变化为 1.87 分，斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.893；最终条纹的 4 处变化均发生在 22 对比较中。 图 7 展示了 22 对和 8 次重复测试的评分变化（仅显示变化，未标注单个存储库），以及第 6 节政策下的最终条纹分布。

paragraphs.en: Within the current panel the judges frequently give identical answers (Table S12 ): 82.6% of the 3,600 judge pairs give an identical answer, and 88.2% of the pairs in which both judges rated, with one pair 2 or more points apart. Raw abstentions are 19.0% of the answers. The engine flags 1 capability as contested, and 92 rated capabilities rest on exactly two accepted judges, with different values for 15 of them. This is agreement among three samples of one model family with one prompt and one context; it is a correlation and not a reliability coefficient or evidence of validity, and the two-panel comparison above is the more informative stability figure. Krippendorff’s α \alpha was not computed as specified in Section 3.5 , since it requires repeated runs and independent judge models. The engine’s quote check found 4,432 of 4,479 rating quotes (99.0%) in the pinned files, and 47 did not verify; the failures are concentrated in a few repositories. 16 quotes verify only in files that were not in the judge’s dossier, which shows that the judges were not confined to the dossier (Section 8 ). Verification is a check that the text exists near the cited line, not that it supports the rating. No formal relevance audit of the final answers was done; an informal review of 50 quotes from the final answers by one reviewer, not blind, found approximately 30–40% weak or indirect (for example a file name, an import line or a single keyword) and 3 of 50 off target, and quotes behind ratings that decide a stripe were in some cases weak, which matters because the 1-versus-2 flag depends on single ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前面板中，评委经常给出相同的答案（表 S12）：在 3600 对评委中，有 82.6% 的配对给出了相同的答案；而在两名评委都进行了评分的配对中，这一比例为 88.2%，其中有一对评委的评分相差 2 分或以上。 直接弃权的答案占所有答案的 19.0%。 该引擎将 1 项能力标记为存在争议，另有 92 项已评分的能力仅基于恰好两名被接受的评委，其中 15 项能力的数值不同。 这是来自同一模型家族、使用相同提示和上下文的三个样本之间的一致性；它是一种相关性，而非可靠性系数或有效性的证据，而上述两个面板的比较则提供了更具信息量的稳定性数据。 Krippendorff’s α \alpha 并未按照第 3.5 节中的规定进行计算，因为它需要重复运行和独立的评委模型。 引擎的引文核查在 4479 条评分引文中找到了 4432 条（99.0%）位于固定文件中，另有 47 条无法验证；这些失败案例主要集中在少数几个存储库中。有 16 条引文仅在评委档案中未包含的文件里得到验证，这表明评委并未局限于使用档案中的内容（第 8 节）。 验证是指检查文本是否存在于所引用的行附近，而非判断其是否支持该评分。 最终答案并未经过正式的相关性审核；一名评审员对最终答案中的 50 条引文进行了非盲测的非正式审查，发现约 30%–40% 的引文较弱或间接（例如文件名、导入行或单个关键词），50 条中有 3 条偏离目标，而用于决定某个等级带的评分所依据的引文在某些情况下也较弱，这一点很重要，因为“1 对 2”的标记取决于单条评分。

paragraphs.en: Workflow 2 demonstrates that the engine’s runtime-evidence path works end to end. It is a method and coverage demonstration only, its numbers are not scores of repositories, and the evidence is probe-run E3 (scenarios, tools and guardrails written for the probe, not the developer’s own runs of a real agent), which cannot reach E4 or lift the proof limit. In its first variant a scripted model replaced the language model for 5 repositories of the sample, plus one framework that could not be instrumented, and an unmodified tracing library (Traccia 0.1.32; Naik et al., 2026 ) wrote local traces that were passed to the engine as runtime observations (Table S16 ); span coverage differed between frameworks because of instrumentation coverage, not because of the frameworks. No final stripe and no proof limit changed, and the score differences of 0.25 to 0.80 points arise only from the step from the static credit of 0.90 to the E3 credit of 0.85.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流 2 表明，该引擎的运行时证据路径能够端到端地正常运行。 这仅是一种方法和覆盖范围的演示，其数值并非来自代码库的得分，而证据是探测运行 E3（为探测编写的场景、工具和护栏，而非开发者自己运行真实智能体的结果），它无法达到 E4 或突破证明限制。 在其第一个变体中，一个脚本化模型取代了语言模型，用于样本中的 5 个代码库，此外还有一个无法进行仪器化的框架，以及一个未经修改的追踪库（Traccia 0.1.32；Naik 等，2026），该库编写了本地追踪数据，并将其作为运行时观察结果传递给引擎（表 S16）；不同框架之间的跨度覆盖差异源于仪器化覆盖范围的不同，而非框架本身。 最终条纹和证明限制均未改变，而 0.25 至 0.80 分的得分差异仅来自从静态信用值 0.90 到 E3 信用值 0.85 的这一步骤。

paragraphs.en: The second variant (the shim study) complements the scripted variant and does not replace it. It replaced only the model by a file-queue shim answered by Claude Sonnet responder subagents, so that the repositories’ own loop code, dispatch and failure handling ran against a non-scripted model in a sandbox with in-process socket guards. It was scored with the study’s re-implemented runtime detectors, not with the frozen engine’s detectors; the engine itself is unchanged. It ran in three rounds with study-authored scenarios (tool success, tool failure, bounded loop, and a guardrail scenario for one framework): round 1 covered 11 repositories with their real toolsets restricted (32 runs, 73 model calls, 99 spans), and round 2 covered 17 repositories with host-touching tools replaced by harmless study stubs or guarded (39 runs, 96 calls, 60 spans), and round 3 covered the 2 offensive-security repositories, run only in stubbed mode with no target, no real tool and guards that raise on any foreign tool (4 runs, 7 calls, 0 spans). All 30 of the 30 selected repositories were attempted, in 75 runs with 176 model calls and 159 spans (Table S17 ); 72 ended normally, one ended at the shim’s own step cap, and 2 timed out because a responder stopped on an API safeguard error, not because of a repository failure. Runtime evidence, meaning at least one span, was obtained for 20 of the 30 repositories; 10 produced none. By span coverage, 17 repositories yielded language-model spans only, 3 yielded tool or agent spans (one of them only through a study-authored telemetry bridge), and 10 yielded none; these classes reflect the coverage of the tracing library’s instrumentation (a synchronous OpenAI client hook, a LangChain callback handler and a few framework integrations; asynchronous, streaming, litellm and requests-based clients are not covered) and not repository properties. Over the 30 repositories, including those with no change, the mean score change against the static scores was − - 0.160 points (median − - 0.173; range − - 1.01 to +0.30), no final stripe changed, and one proof limit changed (from 2 to 4), caused by the study’s own guardrail and tools and not a property of the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种变体（即 shim 研究）是对脚本化变体的补充，而非替代。 它仅将模型替换为文件队列 shim，由 Claude Sonnet 响应子智能体进行应答，从而使得存储库自身的循环代码、调度与故障处理能够在沙盒环境中针对非脚本化模型运行，并配备进程内套接字防护机制。 其评分基于研究中重新实现的运行时检测器，而非冻结引擎的检测器；引擎本身未发生任何变化。 该研究分三轮运行，使用了研究团队设计的场景（工具成功、工具失败、有限循环以及针对某一框架的防护栏场景）：第一轮涵盖 11 个存储库，其真实工具集受到限制（32 次运行，73 次模型调用，99 个跨度）；第二轮涵盖 17 个存储库，涉及主机的工具被替换为无害的研究占位符或受防护（39 次运行，96 次调用，60 个跨度）；第三轮则针对 2 个攻击性安全存储库，仅以占位符模式运行，无目标、无真实工具，且防护机制会对任何外部工具触发异常（4 次运行，7 次调用，0 个跨度）。 所有 30 个选定的存储库均被尝试运行，共进行 75 次运行，涉及 176 次模型调用和 159 个跨度（表 S17）；其中 72 次正常结束，1 次因 shim 自身的步骤上限而终止，另有 2 次因响应器在 API 安全保护错误时停止而超时，而非存储库本身出现故障。 在 30 个存储库中，有 20 个获得了运行时证据（即至少存在一个跨度），另有 10 个未产生任何证据。 从跨度覆盖情况来看：17 个存储库仅产生语言模型跨度，3 个产生工具或智能体跨度（其中一个仅通过研究团队设计的遥测桥接实现），10 个未产生任何跨度；这些类别反映的是追踪库仪器化的覆盖范围（包括同步 OpenAI 客户端钩子、LangChain 回调处理程序及少量框架集成；异步、流式传输、litellm 和基于 requests 的客户端未被覆盖），而非存储库本身的特性。 在全部 30 个存储库中（包括未发生变化的存储库），与静态评分相比的平均得分变化为 − - 0.160 分（中位数为 − - 0.173；范围为 − - 1.01 至 +0.30）；最终评分条未发生任何变化，仅有一个证明限制发生变化（从 2 变为 4），该变化由研究本身的防护栏和工具引起，而非存储库的特性。

paragraphs.en: The shim variant has the following limits (see Section S3.3 ). The model is a non-deterministic Claude responder and not the repository’s intended provider, and the tools and environments are study stubs, so the behaviour of the real tools was not observed; for repositories whose tools are given as prompt text the empty native tool list is not evidence of absence, and in round 3 the responders never called a stub tool live for one of the two repositories, whose tool path was exercised only in a scripted dry test. The bounded-loop scenario was run for 14 of the 30 repositories, and 16 ran only the tool-success and tool-failure scenarios. The responders could see the repository name, the scenario name, the repositories’ own system prompts and absolute local paths (a study path in 1 request of 1 repository); all 176 requests were scanned and none contains earlier results, but the restriction of the responders’ tools was a prompt rule only, and the issued prompts were not archived. The detector observations Runs bounded (any span with an end status) and Runs monitored (any model, usage or cost attribute) need neither a bounded scenario nor a loop limit, and guardrail-dependent observations can fire only from study-authored scaffolding, so they describe the probe as much as the repository. The browser traffic of one repository was restricted by launch flags only, outside the in-process socket guard and without a packet capture, and the socket guards are not an operating-system firewall. No claim is made that any repository has a capability “at E3” or “demonstrated at runtime”, no E4 evidence was obtained, and no score or capability is tied to a named repository. The responder token usage is given in the supplement.
paragraphs.zh: 该 shim 变体具有以下限制（参见第 S3.3 节）。 该模型是一个非确定性的 Claude 响应器，而非该存储库的预期提供者；同时，其工具和环境仅为研究用占位符，因此未观察到真实工具的行为。对于将工具以提示文本形式提供的存储库而言，空的本地工具列表并不能证明工具不存在；在第三轮中，响应器从未对两个存储库中的某一个实际调用过占位符工具，而该工具的调用路径仅在脚本化的模拟测试中被执行过。 有限循环场景在 30 个存储库中的 14 个上运行，另有 16 个仅运行了工具成功和工具失败场景。 响应器可以查看存储库名称、场景名称、存储库自身的系统提示以及绝对本地路径（其中一个存储库的 1 次请求中包含研究路径）；全部 176 次请求均经过扫描，且无一包含早期结果。但响应器工具的受限仅属于提示规则，所发出的提示并未存档。 检测器的观察结果中，“有限运行”（任何具有结束状态的区间）和“受监控运行”（任何模型、使用量或成本属性）既不需要有限场景也不需要循环限制；而依赖防护机制的观察结果只能由研究团队自行搭建的框架触发，因此这些结果既描述了探针本身，也反映了存储库的情况。 其中一个存储库的浏览器流量仅通过启动标志受到限制，未受进程内套接字防护的约束，也未进行数据包捕获；此外，套接字防护并非操作系统防火墙。 本文未声称任何存储库具备“在 E3 阶段”或“在运行时已展示”的能力，也未获得任何 E4 证据，更没有将任何评分或能力与特定名称的存储库关联起来。 响应器的令牌使用量见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: Judging cost, token estimates and harness token usage are reported in the supplement (Section S3.4 ); the judging was not billed per token, and the figures there are estimates under assumptions, not measured costs of an assessment service.

paragraphs.en: The empirical evaluation (Sections 8 and 9 ) is a method demonstration on a purposive sample, with a single judge family and static evidence. This section discusses what it does and does not show.
paragraphs.zh: 经验性评估（第 8 节和第 9 节）是在一个有目的样本上对方法进行的演示，其中仅包含一个法官家庭以及静态证据。 本节将讨论该评估所展示与未展示的内容。

sents.en: The empirical evaluation (Sections 8 and 9 ) is a method demonstration on a purposive sample, with a single judge family and static evidence.
sents.zh: 经验性评估（第 8 节和第 9 节）是在一个有目的样本上对方法进行的演示，其中仅包含一个法官家庭以及静态证据。

sents.en: This section discusses what it does and does not show.
sents.zh: 本节将讨论该评估所展示与未展示的内容。

paragraphs.en: The structure of the result is more informative than its content. With static evidence the proof blocker caps every final stripe at 2 (Section 9.2 ), so the evaluation cannot show whether the repositories are at stripe 2 or at stripe 4, and the distribution of 26 at one stripe and 4 at two says little about the repositories. What the method does separate is what is shown from what is built : the score stripes, which credit what the code appears to contain, lie at three to five, while the stripes that survive the requirement of proof lie at one or two. That gap is a statement about the evidence available to a repository-level assessment, which the specification predicts (Section 3.5 ), and not a finding about the maturity of the agents; a reader who interprets “26 of 30 at one stripe” as a statement that most agents are immature would reverse the reading, since the figure follows from a safety rule applied to excerpts and is unstable (Section 9.3 ). The scores are a coarse summary (the second panel moved individual scores by about two points in the 22 pairs and by about 1.39 points in the 8 panel-only repeats), so they support descriptions of the distribution and not comparisons of single repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 结果的结构比其内容更具信息量。 在静态证据的情况下，证明阻断器将每条最终条纹的上限设为 2（第 9.2 节），因此评估无法判断这些存储库处于条纹 2 还是条纹 4；而一条纹上出现 26 次、两条纹上出现 4 次的分布情况，对了解这些存储库几乎没有任何帮助。 该方法区分了“已展示的内容”与“已构建的内容”：评分条纹反映的是代码表面所含有的内容，其数值位于三到五之间；而通过证明要求的条纹则位于一或二之间。 这一差距反映了存储库层级评估所依据的证据情况，这也是规范文件（第 3.5 节）所预测的结果，而非对智能体成熟度的发现；如果读者将“30 个中有 26 个处于一条纹”解读为大多数智能体尚不成熟的论断，就会得出相反的结论，因为该数据源于对片段应用的安全规则，且并不稳定（第 9.3 节）。 这些评分只是粗略的总结（在 22 组配对中，第二图将个别评分调整了约两分；在仅包含 8 个样本的重测中，则调整了约 1.39 分），因此它们更适合用于描述分布情况，而非对单个存储库进行比较。

sents.en: The structure of the result is more informative than its content.
sents.zh: 结果的结构比其内容更具信息量。

sents.en: With static evidence the proof blocker caps every final stripe at 2 (Section 9.2 ), so the evaluation cannot show whether the repositories are at stripe 2 or at stripe 4, and the distribution of 26 at one stripe and 4 at two says little about the repositories.
sents.zh: 在静态证据的情况下，证明阻断器将每条最终条纹的上限设为 2（第 9.2 节），因此评估无法判断这些存储库处于条纹 2 还是条纹 4；而一条纹上出现 26 次、两条纹上出现 4 次的分布情况，对了解这些存储库几乎没有任何帮助。

sents.en: What the method does separate is what is shown from what is built : the score stripes, which credit what the code appears to contain, lie at three to five, while the stripes that survive the requirement of proof lie at one or two.

paragraphs.en: The only repository-level information in the final stripe is (apart from the basics blocker, which binds for three repositories) a flag decided by one OR-rule over five safety capabilities, and the evaluation shows that the flag is unstable in three ways. It rests on single ratings (13 repositories are at one stripe because of exactly one capability); it gives no signal where the judges abstain, because abstentions cannot trigger a blocker (3 of the 4 two-stripe results depend on a safety capability that was left unassessed); and it is not reproduced by a second panel (4 of 22 final stripes changed, and only 2 repositories are two-stripe in both panels). The eight panel-only repeats (same engine and dossier) changed no final stripe, but all eight sit at one stripe and therefore cannot show changes between one and two stripes, so they do not establish that the flag is stable. The distinction is therefore treated as unreliable, and no repository identity is presented as a stable result. Three consequences for the protocol of Section 7 follow: a blocker should be reported as undetermined when a safety capability is unassessed, with the final stripe shown under both readings; a repeated assessment (outcome (ii)) must use a fresh panel and fresh dossiers, since single-panel agreement (82.6% exact among judge pairs) is far less informative than agreement across panels; and human raters, judges from at least two providers and runtime evidence are most needed for the capabilities that decide the flag. The evaluation also bears on hypothesis H4: the score ordering was nearly unchanged when the static credit changed (Spearman ρ = 0.994 \rho=0.994 ) and less so across panels ( ρ = 0.891 \rho=0.891 on the 22 pairs and ρ = 0.881 \rho=0.881 on the 8 panel-only repeats), and the stripe assignments were the less stable quantity; this is not a test of H4, since the perturbations differ and the sample is purposive, and the pre-registered threshold of ρ ≥ 0.9 \rho\geq 0.9 is not applied (the values straddle it and are descriptive).
paragraphs.zh: 最终条纹中唯一处于仓库级别的信息是（除了绑定三个仓库的基础阻断项外）由五项安全能力通过“或”规则决定的一个标志，而评估显示该标志在三个方面存在不稳定性。 该判断依赖于单一评级（有13个仓库因仅具备一项能力而处于同一条纹）；当评审员弃权时，该判断无法提供明确信号，因为弃权不会触发阻断项（四个双条纹结果中有三个取决于一项未进行评估的安全能力）；此外，第二个评审小组未能复现这一结果（22个最终条纹中有4个发生了变化，且仅有两个仓库在两个小组中均属于双条纹）。 八组仅由评审小组重复评估的案例（使用相同的引擎和档案包）并未改变最终条纹，但这八组案例均处于单条纹状态，因此无法展示单条纹与双条纹之间的变化，因而无法证明该标志具有稳定性。 因此，这一区分被视为不可靠的，且没有任何仓库的身份被作为稳定结果呈现。 由此对第7节协议产生三个后果：当某项安全能力未进行评估时，阻断项应被报告为“未确定”，并在两种解读下均显示最终条纹；重复评估（结果(ii)）必须使用新的评审小组和新的档案包，因为单一评审小组内的一致性（评审员配对中精确一致率为82.6%）远不如跨评审小组的一致性具有信息价值；此外，对于决定该标志的能力而言，最需要的是人类评分员、至少来自两家供应商的评审员以及运行时证据。 该评估也与假设H4相关：当静态信用值发生变化时，分数排序几乎未变（Spearman ρ = 0.994 \rho=0.994），而在不同评审小组之间的变化则较小（在22对样本中 ρ = 0.891 \rho=0.891，在8组仅由评审小组重复评估的案例中 ρ = 0.881 \rho=0.881），且条纹分配是其中较不稳定的变量；这并非对H4的检验，因为扰动方式不同且样本具有目的性选择特征，同时未应用预先注册的阈值 ρ ≥ 0.9 \rho\geq 0.9（这些数值介于阈值两侧，仅具描述性）。

paragraphs.en: Because static code evidence earns 0.90 0.90 and evidence from the developer’s runs earns 0.85 0.85 (Section 8 ), the credit ladder is not monotonic, and moving a rating from E2 to E3 lowers its credit; every probe-run upgrade of the scripted Workflow 2 probe lowered the score slightly, and in the shim variant the median score change over the 30 repositories was − - 0.173 points (range − - 1.01 to +0.30) (Section 9.4 ). The rule is documented, but its justification (the code is the evidence) holds for a licence file and less evidently for a behavioural property such as Runs bounded , where running the code can contradict what reading it supports. The ordering of the scores and the final stripes are unchanged under the one alternative tested (0.70) (0 final-stripe changes, ρ = 0.994 \rho=0.994 ), whereas absolute scores change (mean shift − - 10.72). Two points remain for the specification: the engine applies the higher credit to every code-reading rating, which is broader than the class of static artefacts that Section 3.2 describes and does not enumerate, so the rule should either be stated as blanket or the class listed; and a ladder in which stronger evidence earns less credit creates an unintended incentive that should be examined when the credits are calibrated against outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 由于静态代码证据的得分为 0.90 0.90，而来自开发者运行过程的证据得分为 0.85 0.85（第 8 节），因此信用阶梯并非单调递增的；将评级从 E2 提升至 E3 反而会降低其信用值。在脚本化 Workflow 2 探针的每次探测运行升级中，得分均略有下降；而在 shim 变体中，30 个仓库的得分变化中位数为 − - 0.173 分（范围：− - 1.01 至 +0.30）（第 9.4 节）。 该规则已有文档说明，但其合理性依据（即代码本身即为证据）对许可证文件而言成立，但对于“受约束的运行”这类行为属性则显得不那么明显——因为运行代码的结果可能与阅读代码所得出的结论相矛盾。 在测试的唯一一种替代方案（0.70）下，得分的排序和最终的条纹分布保持不变（最终条纹无变化，ρ = 0.994 \rho=0.994），但绝对得分发生了变化（平均偏移量：− - 10.72）。 关于该规范仍有两点需要明确：首先，引擎对每个代码阅读评级都应用了更高的信用值，这一范围比第 3.2 节所描述但未明确列举的静态产物类别更为广泛，因此该规则应被明确表述为普遍适用，或列出具体适用的类别；其次，若更确凿的证据反而获得更低的信用，这种阶梯机制将产生一种非预期的激励效应，在根据结果对信用值进行校准时应当加以审视。

paragraphs.en: The judges read excerpts, not repositories: a ranked dossier of at most 90,000 characters with each file cut at 14,000, of 8 to 26 files. A rating of 1 on a guard or limit that is missing from the excerpt is an observed absence in the dossier and not in the repository; review of the first eight re-judged repositories found guard code that was not shown for several of them, the final ranking fixed the gap for the agent loop and the README but not for guard code, and the other 22 repositories were not reviewed for it, so a bias towards low ratings for the capabilities that decide the flag is possible. The abstention rate points the same way from the other side: 18.8% of the cells are unassessed, the primary policy excludes them, and a repository with thin coverage is scored on its easier capabilities (the correlation between score and coverage is 0.51). Coverage, the unassessed capabilities and the score under the zero policy are therefore reported with every result (Section 4.1 ), and the instrument and the dossier, not only the judges, are part of the measurement. Quotes are checked for existence, not relevance, so a quote can verify and still be weak (Section 9.3 ); a relevance check, for example by an independent model or by sampling, belongs in the acceptance rules before ratings are used to decide a blocker.
paragraphs.zh: 评审员阅读的是摘录，而非整个存储库：一份最多包含 90,000 个字符的排序档案，每份文件不超过 14,000 个字符，总共有 8 到 26 份文件。 如果某个在摘录中缺失的防护或限制在评分中获得 1 分，则表明该防护在档案中确实不存在，而非存储库中不存在；对首批八个重新评审的存储库的检查发现，其中几个并未展示防护代码，最终排名虽然填补了智能体循环和 README 方面的空白，但并未解决防护代码的问题，而其他 22 个存储库则未对此进行检查，因此，在决定标志的能力上可能存在偏低评分的倾向。 从另一角度来看，弃权率也指向同样的结论：18.8% 的单元格未被评估，主要政策将其排除在外，而覆盖范围有限的存储库则仅根据其较易评估的能力进行评分（分数与覆盖范围的相关系数为 0.51）。 因此，每次结果都会报告覆盖范围、未评估的能力以及零政策下的评分（第 4.1 节），测量过程不仅涉及评审员，还包括工具和档案。 引文仅被检查是否存在，而非是否相关，因此一个引文可能经过验证但仍显得薄弱（第 9.3 节）；例如，通过独立模型或抽样进行的关联性检查，应在使用评分决定阻断项之前纳入接受规则中。

sents.zh: 因此，每次结果都会报告覆盖范围、未评估的能力以及零政策下的评分（第 4.1 节），测量过程不仅涉及评审员，还包括工具和档案。

sents.en: Quotes are checked for existence, not relevance, so a quote can verify and still be weak (Section 9.3 ); a relevance check, for example by an independent model or by sampling, belongs in the acceptance rules before ratings are used to decide a blocker.
sents.zh: 引文仅被检查是否存在，而非是否相关，因此一个引文可能经过验证但仍显得薄弱（第 9.3 节）；例如，通过独立模型或抽样进行的关联性检查，应在使用评分决定阻断项之前纳入接受规则中。

paragraphs.en: The two Workflow 2 variants show that the path from a trace to an evidence level works and that the repositories’ own loop code and stubbed tools can run against a non-scripted model, but that unmodified instrumentation covers only part of what such runs produce (none for 10 of 30), so the detectors for failure surfacing and consequential-action control had little to read. Evidence of E3 or above therefore needs richer instrumentation or traces that the developer submits from real runs; a probe cannot stand in for those, since its scenarios, tools (stubs in rounds 2 and 3) and guardrails are written by the assessor, its model is scripted or a non-deterministic responder, no run reaches E4, and the one proof-limit change is an artefact of the study’s own guardrail and tools. The evaluation shows only that the machinery can accept runtime evidence, not that it changes ratings or stripes (none changed); that is the question for a study with developer-submitted runs (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两种 Workflow 2 变体表明，从追踪到证据级别的流程是可行的，并且存储库自身的循环代码和占位工具可以在非脚本模型上运行；但未经修改的仪器化仅能覆盖此类运行结果的一部分（30 项中无 10 项），因此用于检测故障显现和后续行动控制的探测器几乎没有可读信息。 因此，要获得 E3 或更高证据级别，需要更丰富的仪器化，或者开发者从实际运行中提交的追踪；探针无法替代这些内容，因为其场景、工具（第 2 轮和第 3 轮中的占位）和护栏由评估者编写，其模型是脚本化的或非确定性响应器，没有运行能达到 E4，而唯一关于证明极限的变化是研究本身护栏和工具造成的产物。 该评估仅表明这套机制可以接受运行时证据，而非它会改变评级或等级（没有任何变化）；而开发者提交运行的研究（第 7 节）才会涉及这一问题。

paragraphs.en: The threats to validity of the evaluation concern the judges, the engine, the sample, the instruments and the assessors. All 90 answer sets come from one model family under one alias that is not pinned, with the same prompt and context, so errors are correlated, agreement overstates independence, the run cannot be repeated exactly, no judge was compared with human ratings, and no second model family was used on the final engine. The engine, dossier and judge-sample effects are confounded in the 22 pairs, and the 8 panel-only repeats, which separate them, cover only repositories at one stripe, and the engine was revised after results on the same sample had been seen, so the evaluation describes a method as tuned, not a pre-specified procedure. The sample is purposive, popularity-filtered, Python-primary, permissively licensed and recently active, with 7 frameworks among the 30 repositories and thematic clusters; a repository on GitHub is not a deployed agent, a library target may keep its guards outside the folder assessed, and no inference to agents in general follows. The secrets scanner allowlist suppressed several hundred hits, and a rating of 2 for Secrets protected means that no known-format secret was found outside fixtures, not that its absence was verified. The evaluation was run by the developers of the method, and the judges were not sandboxed. Nothing in the evaluation relates stripes or scores to reliability, incidents or any outcome, and the parameters remain uncalibrated conventions (Table S10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估有效性的威胁涉及评审员、引擎、样本、工具和评估人员。 全部90个答案集均来自一个未固定的别名下的单一模型族，且提示词和上下文相同，因此错误存在相关性，一致性高夸大了独立性，运行过程无法完全重复，没有评审员与人类评分进行比较，最终引擎也未使用第二个模型族。 在22对样本中，引擎、档案和评审员-样本效应相互混淆；而8个仅包含小组的重复测试虽然能区分这些效应，但仅覆盖了单一层级的存储库。此外，在对同一样本得出结果后，引擎才被修订，因此该评估描述的是一种经过调优的方法，而非预先指定的流程。 样本是目的性选择的，经过了流行度过滤、以Python为主、采用宽松许可且近期活跃；在30个存储库中包含了7个框架和主题聚类。GitHub上的一个存储库并不等同于已部署的智能体，目标库可能将防护机制保留在评估文件夹之外，因此无法据此推断出关于智能体的普遍结论。 秘密扫描器的白名单抑制了数百个匹配项，而“秘密保护”评分为2意味着未在固定代码块之外发现任何已知格式的秘密，而非其不存在已得到验证。 该评估由方法开发者执行，且评审员未被置于沙箱环境中。 评估中没有任何内容将层级或分数与可靠性、事件或任何结果相关联，相关参数仍为未经校准的约定（表S10）。

paragraphs.en: The empirical evaluation supports a narrow set of conclusions: the specification can be executed end to end on real repositories, with every stage reproducible from stored ratings (the replay matches 30 of 30 results); static evidence alone cannot produce the upper stripes; the flag that remains is unstable; and the judging, not the arithmetic, is where the instability lies. It does not support any statement about which repositories are better engineered. The roadmap of Section 11 applies, with four additions: agreement reported across fresh panels with independent human raters and judges from at least two providers; a specified treatment of unassessed capabilities in the blocker rules, with the result reported under both readings; runtime evidence from developers’ own runs with instrumentation that covers tool and error events; and samples drawn from a defined frame with a recorded seed (Section 3.5 ). Until then, the stripes of the empirical evaluation are a demonstration of an instrument, and any statement that they indicate reliability, safety or readiness would be unsupported.
paragraphs.zh: 经验性评估支持一组有限的结论：该规范可以在真实代码库中从头到尾执行，并且每个阶段都可以根据存储的评分重复生成（重播与 30 个结果中的 30 个匹配）；仅凭静态证据无法生成上部条纹；剩下的标志是不稳定的；而这种不稳定性存在于判断环节，而非计算环节。 该评估不支持任何关于哪些代码库设计更优的论断。 第 11 节的路线图同样适用，但需补充四点：与至少两家供应商提供的独立人类评分员和评审员组成的新评审小组达成一致的报告；在阻塞规则中对未经评估的能力进行明确处理，并在两种解读下报告结果；来自开发者自身运行且包含工具及错误事件记录的运行时证据；以及从定义明确的样本框中抽取的样本，并记录其种子值（第 3.5 节）。 在此之前，经验性评估中的条纹仅能作为某种工具的演示，任何声称这些条纹表明可靠性、安全性或准备就绪的论断都将缺乏依据。

paragraphs.en: The paper contributes a capability-based, evidence-graded maturity model for one released agent version (Section 3 ), with the calculation from capability ratings to final stripes in five explicit stages. It separates what is measured from what is not (Section 4.1 ); states which parameters are conventions (Table S10 ); compares the method with current standards at topic level (Section 6 ); proposes a prospective validation (Section 7 ); and reports an empirical evaluation on 30 repositories (Sections 8 – 10 ). It complements performance benchmarks and does not replace them.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种基于能力、按证据分级的成熟度模型，适用于一个已发布的智能体版本（第 3 节），该模型通过五个明确阶段，从能力评分计算出最终的等级。 它区分了可衡量与不可衡量的内容（第 4.1 节）；明确了哪些参数属于约定（表 S10）；在主题层面将该方法与当前标准进行了比较（第 6 节）；提出了一项前瞻性的验证方案（第 7 节）；并报告了对 30 个存储库的经验性评估结果（第 8–10 节）。 它是对性能基准的补充，而非替代。

paragraphs.en: The paper does not show the properties that a validated instrument would require. The only empirical material is the empirical evaluation of Section 8 , a method demonstration on a purposive sample with static evidence and one judge family. The stripes have not been shown to predict operational outcomes, the blockers have not been validated against harm, the parameters are not calibrated, and agreement among independent assessors has not been measured; the empirical evaluation reports agreement within one model family and stability across two panels of that family, which are not substitutes (the panel-only repeats of eight repositories at one stripe cannot show changes between one and two stripes). A study that fills these gaps is specified, not conducted. The limitations and their treatment (uncalibrated parameters, no construct or predictive validity, unvalidated blocker rules, unmeasured assessor reliability, same-vendor reference, sampling bias, judge manipulation, reproducibility, conflict of interest and standards alignment) are tabulated with their evidence status in Table S6 .
paragraphs.zh: 该论文并未展示一个经过验证的工具所应具备的特性。 唯一的实证材料是第 8 节中的实证评估，即在一个有意选择的样本上，基于静态证据和一个评审者家族进行的方法演示。 尚未证明这些条纹能够预测实际运行结果，这些阻断规则也未经过对潜在危害的验证，参数尚未校准，且独立评估者之间的一致性也未被测量；实证评估报告了同一模型家族内的一致性以及该家族两个小组之间的稳定性，但这些并不能相互替代（仅使用单一条纹对八个存储库进行重复测试，无法展示从第一条纹到第二条纹的变化）。 论文中明确提出了填补这些空白所需的研究，但并未实际开展。 各项局限性及其处理方式（未校准的参数、缺乏构念效度或预测效度、未经验证的阻断规则、未测量的评估者可靠性、来自同一供应商的参考数据、抽样偏差、评审者操控、可重复性问题、利益冲突以及标准对齐问题）均已在表 S6 中列明，并标注了各自的证据状态。

sents.zh: 该论文并未展示一个经过验证的工具所应具备的特性。

sents.zh: 各项局限性及其处理方式（未校准的参数、缺乏构念效度或预测效度、未经验证的阻断规则、未测量的评估者可靠性、来自同一供应商的参考数据、抽样偏差、评审者操控、可重复性问题、利益冲突以及标准对齐问题）均已在表 S6 中列明，并标注了各自的证据状态。

paragraphs.en: Three points are not fixed by the assessment protocol on which this paper is based and are resolved here by explicit rules (Section 3.4 ): the treatment of unassessed capabilities, the operational form of the rule for emerging capabilities, and the maximum score. The class of static artefacts that earns the higher code credit is not enumerated (Section 8 ), rating anchors for part of the emerging capabilities are unpublished, and the stripe-7 requirement of independent testing is separate from the assessor’s sandbox; these gaps should be closed before a large-scale study.
paragraphs.zh: 本文所依据的评估协议未明确界定三个要点，本文通过明确规则（第 3.4 节）予以解决：未评估能力的处理方式、新兴能力规则的执行形式以及最高得分。 能够获得更高代码信用的静态工件类别并未列出（第 8 节），部分新兴能力的评分基准尚未公布，且第 7 条关于独立测试的要求与评估者的沙箱环境相互独立；在大规模研究之前，这些空白应予以填补。

sents.en: Three points are not fixed by the assessment protocol on which this paper is based and are resolved here by explicit rules (Section 3.4 ): the treatment of unassessed capabilities, the operational form of the rule for emerging capabilities, and the maximum score.
sents.zh: 本文所依据的评估协议未明确界定三个要点，本文通过明确规则（第 3.4 节）予以解决：未评估能力的处理方式、新兴能力规则的执行形式以及最高得分。

sents.en: The class of static artefacts that earns the higher code credit is not enumerated (Section 8 ), rating anchors for part of the emerging capabilities are unpublished, and the stripe-7 requirement of independent testing is separate from the assessor’s sandbox; these gaps should be closed before a large-scale study.
sents.zh: 能够获得更高代码信用的静态工件类别并未列出（第 8 节），部分新兴能力的评分基准尚未公布，且第 7 条关于独立测试的要求与评估者的沙箱环境相互独立；在大规模研究之前，这些空白应予以填补。

paragraphs.en: The most consequential next steps, in order, are: (1) publish capability-specific rating anchors for every capability and close the specification gaps above; (2) repeat the documented assessment on a larger, independently drawn sample of agents (the empirical evaluation of Section 8 did this for 30 repositories with static evidence only), with all applicable capabilities and the requirements of Section 10.4 , storing evidence dossiers and judge-level ratings; (3) obtain human reference ratings from independent experts; (4) run the adversarial tests of Table S5 in an isolated environment; (5) collect E3–E5 evidence so that the upper stripes and credits can be examined; (6) run the prospective study of Section 7 ; and (7) revisit the crosswalk when IEEE P3777 and P3709 publish drafts. Until step (6) is complete, any statement that more stripes mean fewer failures would be unsupported.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来最重要的步骤按顺序如下：(1) 为每一项能力发布特定的评级基准，并填补上述规格方面的空白；(2) 在更大规模、独立抽取的智能体样本上重复已记录评估（第 8 节的实证评估仅针对 30 个仓库且仅使用静态证据），涵盖所有适用能力及第 10.4 节的要求，同时存储证据档案和评审员级别的评级；(3) 从独立专家处获取人类参考评级；(4) 在隔离环境中执行表 S5 中的对抗性测试；(5) 收集 E3–E5 证据，以便能够审查上层条纹和积分；(6) 执行第 7 节中的前瞻性研究；以及 (7) 在 IEEE P3777 和 P3709 发布草案时重新审视对应关系表。 在完成步骤 (6) 之前，任何声称更多条纹意味着更少故障的说法都缺乏依据。

paragraphs.en: AgentStripes is a maturity model for AI agents: it places one released agent version at 0 to 7 stripes through 40 graded capabilities in 12 process areas, graded evidence and explicit aggregation rules. Ratings, evidence levels, a severity-weighted score and gates on basic capabilities, safety and proof determine the final stripes. Deterministic code carries out every step after assessment inputs are accepted. The numerical parameters are conventions, agreement among independent assessors has not been measured, and the stripes have not been validated against operational outcomes, so the model is a proposal to be tested and not a validated or calibrated instrument. An empirical evaluation of 30 public repositories with static evidence ran the specification end to end, illustrated that, by construction, static evidence caps the final stripes at 2, and found that the remaining one-versus-two distinction is unreliable under re-judging (Section 9.3 ): the final stripe changed for 4 of 22 re-judged repositories, and for none of 8 panel-only repeats, which all sit at one stripe and therefore cannot show changes between one and two stripes. The model is intended to complement task benchmarks, and the standards comparison identifies topic overlap and gaps without establishing conformance. The next step is a confirmatory study of a sample of agents with independent human raters and outcome measurements, as specified in Section 7 , rather than a stronger claim.
paragraphs.zh: AgentStripes 是一个用于人工智能智能体的成熟度模型：它将已发布的智能体版本置于 0 到 7 条条纹之间，涵盖 12 个流程领域中的 40 项分级能力，并包含分级证据和明确的聚合规则。 评级、证据级别、严重程度加权分数以及对基本能力、安全性和证明的审查决定了最终的条纹等级。 在评估输入被接受后，确定性代码会执行每一步操作。 这些数值参数仅为约定，独立评估者之间的共识尚未得到验证，条纹等级也未经过与实际运行结果的对照验证，因此该模型仅是一项待测试的提案，而非经过验证或校准的工具。 对包含静态证据的 30 个公开存储库进行的实证评估完整执行了该规范，结果表明，根据设计，静态证据将最终条纹等级限制在 2；此外研究还发现，在重新评估时，其余“1 与 2”的区分并不可靠（第 9.3 节）：在 22 个重新评估的存储库中，有 4 个的最终条纹等级发生了变化，而在仅由专家组重复评估的 8 个存储库中则无一变化，因为它们的条纹等级均为 1，因此无法显示 1 与 2 之间的变化。 该模型旨在补充任务基准测试，而标准对比仅识别出主题的重叠部分和空白领域，并未确立符合性。 下一步是按照第 7 节的规定，对一批智能体样本进行确认性研究，由独立的人类评估员参与并测量结果，而非提出更强烈的主张。

paragraphs.en: Table S18 lists the 30 results of engine 0.2.2. It is the only place in the paper where scores are listed for named repositories; it is ordered alphabetically by repository name, carries no rank and is not a ranking. The scores are valid only as “this panel, this dossier, engine 0.2.2” (Section 9.3 shows that a second panel moved scores by 2.04 points on average and changed 4 of 22 final stripes, whereas a panel-only repeat of the other 8 repositories moved scores by 1.39 points on average and changed no final stripe), and the final stripe of a single repository is not a stable property.

paragraphs.en: The run used study study30 , workflow 1 (static, as is). The engine was agentstripes-v2-engine/ 0.2.2 with capability model agentstripes-maturity-model/2.0.0-draft (40 capabilities in 12 areas). The parameters were: unassessed capabilities excluded ( unassessed=exclude ), emerging capabilities counted only when they raise the running mean ( newer_rule=raise_only ), static-artefact credit on ( static_artefact=True ), no independent review, dossier budget 90,000 characters (14,000 per file), 3 judges per repository, quotes verified. The judges were Claude subagents under the harness alias sonnet , not pinned. Results are stored as workflow1_claude/results/<slug>.judged.json , calculation traces as workflow1_claude/trace/<slug>.md (and all_steps.csv ), judge answers as workflow1_claude/answers/<slug>/judge{1,2,3}.json , and the requests sent to the judges as workflow1_claude/requests/<slug>/ . Sensitivity files are results_sensitivity.csv and sensitivity_static_credit.* , the stability comparison is before_after_22_v022.* , and the cost estimate is cost_if_paid.* . The scripted runtime probes are under workflow2/ and the shim runtime probes of both rounds under workflow2_shim/ . The shim variant was scored with the study’s re-implemented runtime detectors ( runtime_shim.py : per-scenario detection and a broadened treatment of failure events), not with the frozen engine’s detectors; the engine itself is unchanged. The integrity hash list of the study package (954 files) does not cover 38 files of the first Workflow 2 directory or the folder of the panel-only repeats, whose non-modification is therefore not verified by that list. The tables and numbers of the paper are produced from report_workflow1/tables/ and these files by make_results_tex.py , and the figures by make_figures.py . The judge answers cannot be reproduced exactly (no pinned model, no seed). The files named in this paragraph, the engine and the two scripts are held in a private repository ( https://github.com/naiknutan97/evidence-graded-agent-maturity-model ), available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; there, local absolute paths are replaced by placeholders, so files whose paths were replaced no longer match the integrity hash list.
paragraphs.zh: 本次运行使用了 study30 研究以及工作流 1（静态，保持原样）。 引擎为 agentstripes-v2-engine/0.2.2，能力模型为 agentstripes-maturity-model/2.0.0-draft（涵盖 12 个领域的 40 项能力）。 参数设置如下：未评估的能力被排除（unassessed=exclude），新兴能力仅在提升运行均值时计入（newer_rule=raise_only），静态工件信用开启（static_artefact=True），无独立评审，档案预算为 90,000 个字符（每份文件 14,000 字符），每个仓库配备 3 名评审员，引文经过验证。 评审员为 Claude 子智能体，使用 harness 别名 sonnet，且未固定模型版本。 结果存储于 workflow1_claude/results/<slug>.judged.json，计算痕迹存储于 workflow1_claude/trace/<slug>.md（以及 all_steps.csv），评审员答案存储于 workflow1_claude/answers/<slug>/judge{1,2,3}.json，而发送给评审员的请求则存储于 workflow1_claude/requests/<slug>/。 敏感性分析文件为 results_sensitivity.csv 和 sensitivity_static_credit.*，稳定性比较文件为 before_after_22_v022.*，成本估算文件为 cost_if_paid.*。 脚本化的运行时探针位于 workflow2/ 目录下，两轮运行的 shim 运行时探针则位于 workflow2_shim/ 目录下。 shim 变体是使用研究中重新实现的运行时检测器（runtime_shim.py：按场景进行检测，并对故障事件进行了更广泛的处理）进行评分的，而非使用固定引擎的检测器；引擎本身未作更改。 研究包的完整性哈希列表（共 954 个文件）并未涵盖第一版工作流 2 目录中的 38 个文件或仅包含评审小组重复测试的文件夹，因此这些文件的未修改状态无法通过该列表验证。 论文中的表格和数字由 report_workflow1/tables/ 下的文件以及 make_results_tex.py 脚本生成，而图表则由 make_figures.py 生成。 评审员的答案无法完全重现（未固定模型版本，也未设置随机种子）。 本段中提及的文件、引擎及两个脚本均存储在一个私有仓库中（https://github.com/naiknutan97/evidence-graded-agent-maturity-model），可通过合理请求从通讯作者处获取；其中，本地绝对路径已被占位符替换，因此路径被替换的文件不再与该完整性哈希列表匹配。

paragraphs.en: The following artefacts and limits of the shim study complement those in Section 9.4 . Some runs cover only part of a repository: one covers a single executor slice, one a probe-authored executor loop, and several cover only the model-call, parsing and dispatch layers of an agent whose environment is a study stub; one repository keeps its own search wrapper over a stub engine. One agent ended with an exit-format status by stub design (the stub tool bundle has no submit action), not as a repository failure. In round 3 the prompt of one repository still names real tools but its dispatch is guarded, and its responders never called a stub tool live in either scenario; both round-3 repositories produced no spans because of instrumentation coverage. Nine of the 17 round-2 adapters guard against foreign tools with ordinary exceptions that a broad exception handler in a repository could in principle swallow; for those, the request files show only stub tools offered, whereas for repositories that give their tools as prompt text the empty native tool list is not evidence of absence, and their real tool implementations were guarded or not reachable. The other adapters use a guard that such a handler cannot swallow. The bounded-loop scenario was run for 14 of the 30 repositories, and 16 ran only the tool-success and tool-failure scenarios (the guardrail scenario ran for one framework). The test page of one repository was served over loopback Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) instead of a file page, and the responders of some runs stopped on an API safeguard error, so that not all scenarios completed; one repository ran only a reduced path with stubbed vendor data, and one repository needed a pinned dependency version. Several repositories attempted blocked non-loopback lookups (for example of a tokenizer vocabulary host), all refused by the in-process guard. Span coverage was limited by the tracing library’s instrumentation (a synchronous OpenAI client hook, a LangChain callback handler and a few framework integrations): asynchronous clients, streaming paths, litellm and requests-based clients are not covered, so that repositories using them yielded no spans. The span types of the scripted variant (Table S16 ) do not transfer to the shim study. The request files also carry the repositories’ own system prompts and absolute local paths, including temporary paths that contain the local account name, which must be scrubbed before any release of the queue files.
paragraphs.zh: 以下关于 shim 研究的产物和限制补充了第 9.4 节中的内容。 部分运行仅覆盖仓库的一部分：一次运行仅覆盖单个执行器切片，一次运行覆盖由探针编写的执行器循环，还有几次运行仅覆盖模型调用、解析和调度层，而该智能体的环境是一个研究占位符；一个仓库在占位符引擎之上保留了自己的搜索包装器。 由于占位符设计，一个智能体最终以退出格式状态结束（占位符工具包没有提交操作），而非因仓库失败所致。 在第 3 轮中，一个仓库的提示仍然命名了真实工具，但其调度受到保护，且其响应器在任何一种情况下都从未实际调用过占位符工具；由于仪器覆盖问题，这两个第 3 轮的仓库均未生成任何跨度。 在 17 个第 2 轮适配器中，有 9 个通过普通异常来防范外来工具，而这些异常原则上可以被仓库中的广泛异常处理程序捕获；对于这些情况，请求文件仅显示所提供的占位符工具，而对于那些将工具作为提示文本提供的仓库而言，空的本地工具列表并不能证明工具不存在，且其真实工具实现受到保护或无法访问。 其他适配器使用了一种无法被此类处理程序捕获的保护机制。 在 30 个仓库中，有 14 个运行了有限循环场景，另有 16 个仅运行了工具成功和工具失败场景（其中一个框架运行了护栏场景）。 一个仓库的测试页面通过回环超文本传输协议（HTTP）提供服务，而非文件页面，且部分运行的响应器因 API 安全保护错误而停止，因此并非所有场景都完成；一个仓库仅运行了包含占位符供应商数据的简化路径，另一个仓库则需要固定版本的依赖项。 多个仓库尝试进行了被阻止的非回环查找（例如对分词器词汇表主机的查找），但均被进程内保护机制拒绝。 跨度覆盖受到追踪库仪器化的限制（一个同步的 OpenAI 客户端挂钩、一个 LangChain 回调处理程序以及少数框架集成）：异步客户端、流式传输路径、litellm 和基于 requests 的客户端未被覆盖，因此使用这些技术的仓库未产生任何跨度。 脚本化变体中的跨度类型（表 S16）不适用于 shim 研究。 请求文件还包含仓库自身的系统提示和绝对本地路径，包括包含本地账户名的临时路径，在发布队列文件之前必须清除这些信息。
