paragraphs.en: The judging used Claude subagents and was not billed per token, so no per-token fee was charged. With tokens estimated as characters divided by four (2,907,726 input and 400,230 output tokens for the 30 current results), the same calls priced at the OpenAI gpt-5.4 family (the Claude prices were not available) would cost $1.08 (nano), $3.98 (mini) or $13.27 for the full model. Provider-reported harness tokens exist only for the eight repositories judged first on the final engine (2,990,063 tokens, 24 judges) and for the panel-only repeat of the same eight (2,973,218 tokens, 24 judges), so there is no complete harness total; the superseded runs are not counted, and the scripted probe runs used no language-model call and about 17 seconds in total. These are estimates under assumptions, not measured costs of an assessment service. The responder subagents of the Workflow 2 shim study used about 3.9 million harness tokens in total (3,932,643 as summed from partly approximate reports; round 1 about 1.48 million, round 2 about 2.05 million, round 3 about 0.4 million; the total includes about 118 thousand tokens of a discarded first attempt, flagged as cost); this is a lower bound, because the reports of one repository are incomplete, and these tokens are not included in the estimates above.
paragraphs.zh: 评审过程使用了 Claude 子智能体，且未按令牌计费，因此没有产生每令牌的额外费用。 若将令牌数估算为字符数除以四（当前 30 个结果的输入令牌为 2,907,726，输出令牌为 400,230），则使用 OpenAI gpt-5.4 系列模型执行相同调用（Claude 的定价信息不可用）的费用将分别为：nano 版 1.08 美元、mini 版 3.98 美元，或完整模型版 13.27 美元。 供应商报告的集成环境令牌数据仅存在于最终引擎中首批评审的八个仓库（2,990,063 个令牌，24 位评审员）以及仅由评审小组重复评审相同八个仓库的情况（2,973,218 个令牌，24 位评审员），因此不存在完整的集成环境总令牌数；被替换的运行不计入统计，而脚本化探测运行未使用任何语言模型调用，总耗时约 17 秒。 这些是基于假设的估算值，而非评估服务的实际测量成本。 Workflow 2 shim 研究中的响应子智能体总共使用了约 390 万个集成环境令牌（根据部分近似的报告汇总得出为 3,932,643；第一轮约 148 万，第二轮约 205 万，第三轮约 40 万；总数包含一个被弃用的首次尝试中约 11.8 万个令牌，该部分已标记为成本）；这是一个下限值，因为其中一个仓库的报告不完整，且这些令牌未包含在上述估算中。

sents.en: The 7 non-emerging capabilities with an accepted rating give ∑ w i ​ c i = 8.3333 \sum w_{i}c_{i}=8.3333 and ∑ w i = 14 \sum w_{i}=14 , a running mean of 0.5952.
sents.zh: 7 项获得认可评级的非新兴能力得出 ∑ w i ​ c i = 8.3333 \sum w_{i}c_{i}=8.3333 和 ∑ w i = 14 \sum w_{i}=14，当前均值为 0.5952。

sents.en: The two emerging capabilities are tried in descending order of credit and added only when their credit exceeds the running mean: 1 was added and 1 skipped.
sents.zh: 两项新兴能力按信用值降序进行尝试，且仅当它们的信用值超过当前均值时才会被添加：1 被添加，而 1 被跳过。

paragraphs.en: Steps 3 to 5 give the score and the score stripes: S = 100 × 10.1333 / 16 = 63.333 S=100\times 10.1333/16=63.333 over 8 counted capabilities, and s score = min ⁡ ( 7 , ⌊ 63.333 / 12.5 ⌋ ) = 5 s_{\mathrm{score}}=\min(7,\lfloor 63.333/12.5\rfloor)=5 . The coverage is κ = 0.900 \kappa=0.900 .

sents.en: Steps 3 to 5 give the score and the score stripes: S = 100 × 10.1333 / 16 = 63.333 S=100\times 10.1333/16=63.333 over 8 counted capabilities, and s score = min ⁡ ( 7 , ⌊ 63.333 / 12.5 ⌋ ) = 5 s_{\mathrm{score}}=\min(7,\lfloor 63.333/12.5\rfloor)=5 .
The coverage is κ = 0.900 \kappa=0.900 .
sents.zh: 覆盖率为 κ = 0.900。

paragraphs.en: Step 6 evaluates the blockers. The basics cap is 7 (none of the four basics is rated below 1) and the safety cap is 7 (no safety capability is rated below 2). The proof cap is 2: the weakest evidence level among the safety behaviours is E2, below E3, as it is for every static assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 第 6 步评估阻碍因素。 基础能力上限为 7（四项基础能力中没有任何一项的评分低于 1），安全能力上限为 7（没有任何一项安全能力的评分低于 2）。 证据能力上限为 2：在所有安全行为中，最弱的证据等级为 E2，低于 E3，这与所有静态评估的情况一致。

sents.en: Step 6 evaluates the blockers.
sents.zh: 第 6 步评估阻碍因素。

sents.en: The basics cap is 7 (none of the four basics is rated below 1) and the safety cap is 7 (no safety capability is rated below 2).
sents.zh: 基础能力上限为 7（四项基础能力中没有任何一项的评分低于 1），安全能力上限为 7（没有任何一项安全能力的评分低于 2）。

sents.en: The proof cap is 2: the weakest evidence level among the safety behaviours is E2, below E3, as it is for every static assessment.
sents.zh: 证据能力上限为 2：在所有安全行为中，最弱的证据等级为 E2，低于 E3，这与所有静态评估的情况一致。

paragraphs.en: Step 7 gives the final stripes: s final = min ⁡ ( 5 , 7 , 7 , 2 ) = 2 s_{\mathrm{final}}=\min(5,7,7,2)=2 , with the proof blocker binding. The arithmetic of every real result is recorded in its calculation trace, and a replay of the engine’s scoring on the stored ratings reproduces the score and the final stripes for 30 of 30 results; this checks the arithmetic, not the ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 第 7 步给出了最终的条纹：s_final = min(5, 7, 7, 2) = 2，此时证明阻断器已绑定。 每个实际结果的算术运算都记录在其计算轨迹中，而通过重播引擎对已存储评级的评分过程，可以重现这 30 个结果中的全部 30 个得分和最终条纹；这验证的是算术运算，而非评级本身。
